title: USS MAKIN ISLAND (LHD 8) FY28 Docking Selected Restricted Availability (DSRA) Request for Proposal(s)
description: The Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA) issues solicitation N00024-26-R-4421 for the execution of the USS MAKIN ISLAND (LHD 8) FY28 Docking Selected Restricted Availability (DSRA). This Signature Availability includes a combination of maintenance, modernization, and repair, and will require highly capable contractors with substantial facilities, to include capable pier (for the applicable ship class) as well as human resources capable of completing, coordinating, and integrating multiple areas of ship maintenance, repair and modernization. This Signature Availability is solicited on a coast-wide basis on the West Coast under a single solicitation, and one (1) contract to complete the availability is expected to be awarded to one (1) contractor. Based on the complexity, magnitude and duration of the requirement, the Governments market research indicates there are not two or more small business concerns capable of competing for these requirements and therefore this procurement will not be set aside for small business (FAR 19.502-2(b)). This solicitation is issued electronically via PIEE and interested parties must comply with this announcement. Interested offerors should monitor the PlEE.gov and SAM.gov pages for the release of the solicitation and any applicable amendments, thereafter. Offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) to participate in this procurement at https://www.sam.gov. All responsible sources may submit a proposal, which shall be considered by the agency. This posting does not include all relevant attachments. Potential offerors will need to request access to all applicable CDRLs, J- and S- attachments by providing a written request to the Contract Specialist, Jacob Juros at jacob.a.juros.civ@us.navy.mil and the Contracting Officer, Brian Romano, at brian.c.romano.civ@us.navy.mil. Include your companys SAM Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) number with the request so that contractor status can be confirmed in the System for Award Management. These attachments will be transmitted via DoD SAFE. ***NOTICE*** In addition, there are references that contain limiting distribution statements and will not be disseminated from the Contract Specialist. In these instances, Offerors shall contact the Southwest Regional Maintenance Center (SWRMC) Technical Librarian at swrmc.techdocs@us.navy.mil to arrange access per RFP Section L instruction. Offerors shall review Section L, General Information for further details. ***END NOTICE***The Government anticipates making a single award in or before March 2027. USS MAKIN ISLAND (LHD 8) FY28 DSRA will begin in November 2027 with an expected completion in October 2029.

title: Fort Leonard Wood BASOPS Solicitation
description: The contractor shall perform the BASOPS work in accordance with the Performance Work Statement (PWS), herein identified as Annex A Overarching PWS.Requirements: The Government will issue a Firm Fixed Price (FFP), non-personal services contract as defined under the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) 561210- Facilities Support Services to provide Base Operations Maintenance and Support Services (BASOPS), which include six (6) functional areas covered under this PWS: Grounds Maintenance, Pavement Clearance (Snow, Ice, and Sand Removal), Facility Maintenance, Facility Maintenance - Horizontal, Heating and Cooling Services, and Army Cemetery. The Government will not exercise any supervision or control over the contract service providers. The Contractor shall perform to the standards specified in this Performance Work Statement (PWS). Contract service providers shall be accountable solely to the Contractor who, in turn is responsible to the Government. The Contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, supervision, and other items and non-personal services necessary as defined in this PWS. The Contractor is responsible for providing all parts required for Preventive Maintenance Orders (PMOs) and all repair parts required for Demand Maintenance Orders (DMOs). This is an 8(a) small business set-aside. See Annex A Overarching PWS.

title: Commercial Solutions Opening for Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2)
description: Amendment 01 dated 12 July 2021: Updated "CSO" to read "Commercial Solutions Opening" in an effort to prevent confusion with other acronyms. Federal Agency: Air Force Program Office: AFLCMC/XA �Architecture and Integration Directorate� CSO Title: JADC2 Commercial Solutions Opening CSO Type: Commercial Solutions Opening with Calls CSO Number: FA8612-21-S-C001 CSO Date: June 28, 2021 NOTE This is only an announcement; PLEASE DO NOT SUBMIT PROPOSALS IN RESPONSE. Subsequent calls will be issued under this announcement to solicit proposals for specific efforts. Please refer to the attachment section of this announcement for the calls. Publication of this announcement does not obligate the DoD to review any white papers submission beyond an initial administrative review, or to award any specific project, or to obligate any available funds. 1.0 OVERVIEW This Commercial Solutions Opening is intended to be as streamlined as possible to allow the Architecture and Integration Directorate (AFLCMC/XA), or any organization AFLCMC/XA supports, to leverage the latest technology advances from a large variety of prospective Contractors. AFLCMC/XA invites innovative technical approach proposals addressing Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2) problems associated with getting the right information to the right platform/decision maker in the most efficient manner thereby reducing kill chain and Observe, Orient, Decide and Act (OODA) timelines and cycles. This Commercial Solutions Opening will focus on existing and emerging technologies and platforms across the Defense Department, the Intelligence Community, and the commercial world, to perform an integrated analysis of the capability of various options to contribute to the fight and prioritize investments over time. This solicitation is not requesting any white papers or proposals at this time. This Commercial Solutions Opening functions as the overarching umbrella solicitation from which Calls will be published. This Commercial Solutions Opening will remain open for Calls until rescinded. This Commercial Solutions Opening can result in the award of FAR Part 12 Contracts, Procurement for experimental purposes under 10 U.S.C. 4023 or Other Transaction Agreements (OTAs) under 10 USC 4021. Over the course of this time period, AFLCMC/XA will publish Calls via amendments to this Commercial Solutions Opening. These Calls will contain specific Areas of Interest (AoIs) related to JADC2�s Technology Focus Areas. Those specific AoIs are what prospective Contractors shall focus their solutions towards. This is a competitive solicitation that seeks to fund innovative technologies that propose new solutions to expand Air Force capabilities as it relates to JADC2 Technology Focus Areas. AFLCMC/XA is interested in receiving responses from all interested offerors to include, but not limited to, the following: traditional defense contractors, nontraditional defense contractors, large businesses, small businesses and research institutions. The Commercial Solutions Opening is a streamlined acquisition process that seeks to reduce acquisition timelines and acquire new, innovative solutions that companies can bring forth to meet the stated AoIs detailed in each Call. All details of the process shall be governed by this Commercial Solutions Opening unless otherwise noted or expanded upon in each Call. AFLCMC/XA is not obligated to make any awards as a result of this Commercial Solutions Opening and all awards are subject to the availability of funds and successful negotiations. The Government is not responsible for any monies expended by the proposer prior to the issuance of any contract award. AFLCMC/XA reserves the right to modify the solicitation requirements of this Commercial Solutions Opening and each subsequent Call. The Commercial Solutions Opening authority reference to Class Deviation 2022-O0007. 2.0 Commercial Solutions Opening with Calls This Commercial Solutions Opening is a hybrid solicitation against which both Closed Calls and/or Open Period Calls can be published via amendments to the Commercial Solutions Opening. All Calls issued under this Commercial Solutions Opening will include specific instructions including dates, AoIs, evaluation criteria and proposal instructions to potential offerors. title: Contract Opportunity Network Enabled Weapons Trainer (NEWT)
description: DISCLAIMER: THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI)/ SOURCES SOUGHT FOR WHITE PAPERS ONLY. THERE IS NO SOLICITATION AT THIS TIME. The Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR) is conducting market research to identify potential industry sources and commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) capabilities. The PMX-201 Precision Strike Weapons, Effects Deployment Office (FXDO), Network Enabled Weapons Trainer (NEWT) Program requests interested parties submit a white paper detailing their proposed approach or existing capability to develop, manufacture, and maintain an airworthy, Aircraft Carrier suitable store[JN1] [CM2] that will emulate all Air launched DOW Network Enabled Weapons (NEW). SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS: Format: White papers must be submitted in PDF/Microsoft Word format. Page Limit: Responses shall not exceed 8 pages, excluding the cover page. Font: Times New Roman or Arial, 11-point font or larger. Deadline: All submissions must be received no later than (NLT) Date will be determined 09 November 2026, 5 pm Eastern Standard Time. Delivery: Submit via email to breanne.n.jilcott.civ@us.navy.mil with the subject line: Response to N00019-25-RFPREQ-WPM201-0360 � Company Name The Government acknowledges that white papers may contain proprietary or trade secret information. All proprietary information contained in the response must be clearly marked. The Government will safeguard properly marked proprietary information from unauthorized disclosure in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. Please do not submit classified information or pricing information in response to this RFI. Please provide the following information: 1. Company Name and Address 2. Cage Code and UEI Number 3. Company business size by NAICS code 4. Small Business Type(s), if applicable 5. Point of Contact for questions and/or clarifications (Name, Title, Phone, Email) 6. Telephone Number and email address 7. Web Page URL (if applicable) 8. Teaming Partners (if applicable) 9. Information regarding the viability to receive and process classified information with appropriate contact information 10. Provide any recommendations and/or concerns. 11. Location(s) of work to be performed. Capabilities Statement: � Provide a detailed description of your company's experience, capabilities, and planned approach to develop and manufacture the following: Provide an agnostic Captive Carriage Network Enabled Weapons Trainer (NEWT) to emulate all Network Enabled Weapons (NEWs) employed by aircraft in the DoN inventory. This trainer will have the following: Supportable Platforms The NEWT shall be captive carried from DoN fixed wing platforms that employ Network-Enabled Weapons. The NEWT shall meet exportability requirements to FVEY. Reliability The NEWT shall have a minimum power on time of 4 hrs with a 30 min cool off period for Strike Fighter training, during which the NEWT can be cold soaked at altitude. Maritime Patrol and Reconnaissance Force (MPRF) is 12-hour power-on operations. [JN5] [CM6] This includes power on deck (BIT, Mission Planning download, crypto verification) and power while airborne. BLOS communications are needed pre-employment, employment and post simulated launch of long-range NEWs. Supportability The NEWT shall be capable of off-aircraft BIT/ reprogramming using existing CMBRE or other follow-on systems. The NEWT shall be compatible with existing support equipment and test equipment (GSE). Ground Crew shall be able to change the NEWT to the weapon it is emulating without downloading the NEWT from the aircraft.[JN7] [CM8] The NEWT shall focus on software modularity instead of hardware interchangeability. The NEWT shall not require liquids or gases that need to be refilled. Program Protection The NEWT shall minimize or eliminate weapons CPI content. The NEWT shall meet current AT / Cyber standards for new hardware (if not already flight proven hardware). Environmental/Structural The NEWT shall be designed for the carrier environment. The NEWT shall be designed for a Vmax of 1.2 IMN The NEWT shall be reusable with a maximum down time of 45 minutes between flights. The NEWT life shall maximize the number of catapults and arrestments. Once the NEWT has reached its service life, maintenance actions to return to flying status are limited to the Organizational (O) and Intermediate (I) level maintenance[JN9] [CM10] . Connectivity The NEWT shall utilize all NEW waveforms The NEWT shall be capable of operating between 0-6 GHz including, but not limited to WF L, WF X, WF S, WF Y, and Link-16. The NEWT radio shall be software defined to allow for future waveform growth Hardware The NEWT shall minimize testing requirements to be cleared on the aircraft platform. The NEWT shall be inert with no energetic components The NEWT shall have a clear view of the sky for its own antennas to enter required networks; the NEWT shall not depend on the aircraft platform to communicate with external architecture. The NEWT�s antennas shall be integrated into its Outer Mold Line (OML) and not require deployment of any doors or other mechanisms. The NEWT shall use primary power from the launch platform power source. System Performance The NEWT shall be integrated with the Navy's broader network-centric warfare systems, enabling coordinated operations and enhanced situational awareness. The NEWT shall notify the platform of the receipt and acceptance of Inflight Target Updates (IFTUs).[JN11] [CM12] The NEWT shall exercise the network and weapon mission planning processes to include Cryptographic Key Material handling. The NEWT shall not utilize the onboard processing capacity of the host platform. The NEWT shall be capable of all required processing capabilities with 50% growth available. All processing power will be handled internally to the NEWT. This does not include any processing power the platform will need for cockpit display of IFTU[JN13] [CM14] reception and fly-out. The NEWT shall use the aircraft/weapon interface for the weapon it is emulating (UAI, common flex, 1760, etc) The NEWT shall utilize current Fleet released mission planning system (JMPS/CMPC) as the respective NEW weapon that NEWT is emulating. An emphasis should be placed on minimizing unique planning that deviates from actual weapon mission planning. The NEWT shall be designed for net entry while on the ground, and airborne if NEWT is secured for takeoff. The NEWT shall ingest live, virtual, and constructive tracks from both the continuous learning environment and real-world networks. The NEWT shall emulate the respective dynamic LAR of the weapon that NEWT is emulating. The NEWT shall be designed with future proofing in mind. Future upgrades could involve but not limited to: Open Architecture. Inject new waveforms. Computing power, firmware memory and processor reserve of 50% or greater for future growth. The NEWT shall record data for post flight debrief/analysis including but not limited to: Supply power to the data recorder upon NEWT startup. Enable rapid post flight data extraction via removeable storage or electronic extraction to ensure seamless integration with JMPS / CMPC processing workflows. Maintain open physical and logical access to the memory interface (removeable / electronic) during host aircraft operations with NEWT loaded. Record BLOS IFTUs received and processed Record release conditions at simulated launch. The NEWT shall minimize platform MC code impact. This RFI is issued solely for information and planning purposes�it does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. This request does not commit the U.S. Government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. Further, the Government is not at this time seeking proposals and will not accept unsolicited proposals. Responders are advised that the U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this RFI; all costs associated with responding to this RFI will be solely at the in

Font exception les trois sites qui doivent faire l’objet d’une offre concrète dans le cadre du présent appel d’offres : leurs adjudicataires se verront octroyer le droit de conclure un contrat subséquent pour le ou les sites concernés. title: Netherlands – Blood-testing reagents – Gevalideerde Totaaloplossing voor de hielprikscreening op stofwisselingsziekten met behulp van massaspectrometrie voor meerdere Laboratoria
description: De neonatale hielprikscreening (NHS) is een landelijk screeningsprogramma dat wordt uitgevoerd bij pasgeborenen in de eerste week na de geboorte. In Nederland (Europees en Caribisch Nederland) krijgen jaarlijks ca. 170.000 pasgeborenen de hielprik. De hielprikscreening is het langstlopende landelijke screeningsprogramma in de publieke gezondheidszorg. De analyse van het hielprikbloed levert op dit moment belangrijke informatie op over zevenentwintig zeldzame, vaak erfelijke, ernstige aandoeningen. Het bloedonderzoek wordt vanaf 2026 verricht door drie Screeningslaboratoria, waarvan het Screeningslaboratorium van RIVM-GZB fungeert als Referentielaboratorium. De Screeningslaboratoria zijn verantwoordelijk voor de analyse van het hielprikbloedmonster en een tijdige rapportage van de uitslag. Het bloedonderzoek op de aanwezigheid van vijftien van de zeventwintig ziekten wordt momenteel uitgevoerd door middel van massaspectrometrie. In verband met de vereiste uniforme uitvoering van de analyses dienen de drie Screeningslaboratoria dezelfde Tandem massaspectrometrie apparatuur met bijbehorende multiplex kit te gebruiken. Om de uniformiteit, kwaliteit en efficiency te borgen heeft het RIVM besloten om de apparaten (hardware), software, reagentia en bijbehorend onderhoud (preventief, correctief, adaptief), ook wel Totaaloplossing genoemd, in te kopen en ter beschikking te stellen aan de Screeningslaboratoria. Deze Aanbestedingsprocedure betreft een opdracht voor de levering, implementatie en onderhoud van een gevalideerde Totaaloplossing voor de hielprikscreening voor de Screeningslaboratoria. Het doel van deze Europese aanbesteding is het sluiten van een Overeenkomst met één Leverancier, volgens het principe van reagent rental waarbij de Leverancier eigenaar blijft van de apparatuur. De Leverancier wordt volledig verantwoordelijk voor het leveren, implementeren en doorlopend ter beschikking stellen van de Totaaloplossing en het verrichten van daaraan verwante diensten overeenkomstig de specificaties die zijn neergelegd in de Aanbestedingsstukken. Tevens omvat deze Aanbestedingsprocedure de aanschaf van een massaspectrometer / vloeistofchromatografie systeem voor in het Referentielaboratorium van RIVM-GZB (inclusief hardware, software en onderhoud).

title: John Day Dam Powerhouse HVAC Upgrades
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Portland District (NWP) has a requirement for HVAC upgrades at the John Day Dam (JDA) Powerhouse. JDA is approximately 109 miles east of Portland, Oregon, and 275 miles from Seattle, Washington. JDA spans two states, with Units 1�14 located in Sherman County, Oregon, and Units 15�16 in Klickitat County, Washington. CMMC: Contractors are advised that Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Level 2 (Self) certification is required prior to obtaining the contract drawings containing CUI and prior to contract award. Solicitation documents may be restricted to only those offerors who demonstrate current CMMC Level 2 (Self) compliance. Prior to receiving solicitation documents with CUI, offerors must affirm their CMMC status to maintain eligibility; failure to meet this requirement will result in elimination from further consideration. CMMC requirements apply to prime contractors and subcontractors throughout the supply chain at all tiers that will process, store, or transmit any FCI or CUI on contractor information systems in the performance of this DoD contract or subcontract. Prime contractors shall comply and shall require subcontractors to comply with and to flow down CMMC requirements, such that compliance will be required throughout the supply chain at all tiers with the applicable CMMC level and assessment type for each subcontract as follows: If a subcontractor will only process, store, or transmit FCI (and not CUI) in performance of the subcontract, then a CMMC Status of Level 1 (Self) is required for the subcontractor. If a subcontractor will process, store, or transmit CUI in performance of the subcontract, then a CMMC Status of Level 2 (Self) is the minimum requirement for the subcontractor. Summary of Work: Work includes but is not limited to the following: Complete replacement of the primary and installation of secondary chillers on two chilled water loops serving the majority of the Powerhouse galleries. Demolition and removal of the existing system and installation of four new chiller skid packages totaling approximately 600 tons of refrigeration capacity. New electrical feeds, chilled water pumps, piping, and air handler units, with selective reuse of existing components. Systems must be integrated into a new automated digital HVAC control system. Half of the new systems will be water-cooled; half will be converted to air-cooled. For the air-cooled units, roof-mounted air-cooled condensers will be installed, requiring roof penetrations, piping, and building modifications. HVAC upgrades include new intake and exhaust ducting to prevent smoke propagation through the building in the event of fire, and fire protection measures at all penetrations. HVAC and the building fire protection systems must be fully integrated, replacing all existing pneumatic controls with an integrated digital control system which is capable of functioning to selectively shut down the HVAC to isolate sectors in the event of a fire or smoke event. The work includes mechanical and controls provisions for free cooling using passive outside air during cold nights and modifications to existing intakes, louvers, and penetrations to support smoke ventilation. Localized HVAC units such as mini-splits will be installed for specific spaces, with new electrical supplies, piping, insulation, penetrations, and data reporting to the central HVAC control system. Work will be performed in an active, operational Powerhouse with 6000A, 13.8kV busbars and other heavy electrical equipment, including areas below headwater with nuisance water intrusion risks. Certain pumps must remain operational throughout construction, presenting noise and safety hazards that must be managed. The existing fire suppression system must remain active during construction and be recommissioned upon project completion. Work includes ductwork installation and protection of floor penetrations in close proximity to operational high-voltage electrical busbars, emphasizing strict delineation and safety control of work areas. New systems to be installed must not use refrigerants subject to future refrigerant phase-out schedules (no refrigerant subject to phase-out at any point in the future may be used). Work includes extensive structural penetrations and modifications to support permanent equipment installation including piping, ductwork and new condensing systems. Asbestos abatement and lead mitigation may be required. The anticipated completion date for physical construction is 1,004 calendar days after receiving the Notice to Proceed. The solicitation will be issued as an Invitation for Bids (IFB). This acquisition will result in a single firm-fixed-price contract. The estimated magnitude of construction is between $25M and $100M. This procurement is unrestricted/full and open competition. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this action is 238220; Plumbing, Heating, and Air-Conditioning Contractors with a small business size standard of $19M. One or more of the items under this acquisition is subject to the World Trade Organization Government Procurement Agreement and Free Trade Agreements. This synopsis is not a request for quotes (RFQ), proposals (RFP), or in an invitation for bids (IFB). This is a pre-solicitation notice indicating that a solicitation for a competitive acquisition for the award of one firm-fixed-price contract is intended to be issued via Contract Opportunities at SAM.gov. The tentative solicitation issuance date is June 2026. The solicitation will not be issued less than 15 days from the date of this notice. The specifications and drawings will be included with the solicitation once issued. This announcement is for information and planning purposes only and is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government, implied or otherwise, to issue a solicitation or award a contract. Bids will be due not less than 30 days from the date the solicitation is issued. The definitive bid due date and time will be stated in the solicitation and any associated amendments that may be issued. Contractors are responsible for checking this page for any update(s) to this notice. title: John Day Dam Powerhouse HVAC Upgrades
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Portland District (NWP) has a requirement for HVAC upgrades at the John Day Dam (JDA) Powerhouse. JDA is approximately 109 miles east of Portland, Oregon, and 275 miles from Seattle, Washington. JDA spans two states, with Units 1�14 located in Sherman County, Oregon, and Units 15�16 in Klickitat County, Washington. Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC). This solicitation requires the contractor and/or subcontractor(s) information system to process, store, or transmit Federal Contract Information (FCI) or Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), and requires the contractor and/or subcontractor(s) to comply with CMMC requirements. The CMMC level required by this solicitation is: CMMC Level 2 (Self). This CMMC level, or higher, is a condition of award. Prior to award, the apparent successful offeror must have a current CMMC status at Level 2 (Self), or higher, posted in SPRS for each relevant CMMC UID in order to remain eligible for award; failure to meet this requirement will render the offeror ineligible for contract award. CMMC requirements apply to prime contractors and subcontractors throughout the supply chain at all tiers that will process, store, or transmit any FCI or CUI on contractor information systems in the performance of this DoD contract or subcontract. Prime contractors shall comply and shall require subcontractors to comply with and to flow down CMMC requirements, such that compliance will be required throughout the supply chain at all tiers with the applicable CMMC level and assessment type for each subcontract as follows: If a subcontractor will only process, store, or transmit FCI (and not CUI) in performance of the subcontract, then a CMMC status of Level 1 (Self) is required for that subcontractor. If a subcontractor will process, store, or transmit CUI in performance of the subcontract, then a CMMC status of Level 2 (Self), or higher, is required for that subcontractor, and must be current in SPRS prior to subcontract award. Prime contractors are responsible for ensuring that all covered subcontractors obtain and maintain the appropriate CMMC level and assessment type for the information they will process, store, or transmit during performance. For this solicitation, contractors requesting access to documents containing FCI or CUI must have an active SAM registration and a current NIST SP 800?171 assessment with at least a Basic confidence level recorded in SPRS. Summary of Work: Work includes but is not limited to the following: Complete replacement of the primary and installation of secondary chillers on two chilled water loops serving the majority of the Powerhouse galleries. Demolition and removal of the existing system and installation of four new chiller skid packages totaling approximately 600 tons of refrigeration capacity. New electrical feeds, chilled water pumps, piping, and air handler units, with selective reuse of existing components. Systems must be integrated into a new automated digital HVAC control system. Half of the new systems will be water-cooled; half will be converted to air-cooled. For the air-cooled units, roof-mounted air-cooled condensers will be installed, requiring roof penetrations, piping, and building modifications. HVAC upgrades include new intake and exhaust ducting to prevent smoke propagation through the building in the event of fire, and fire protection measures at all penetrations. HVAC and the building fire protection systems must be fully integrated, replacing all existing pneumatic controls with an integrated digital control system which is capable of functioning to selectively shut down the HVAC to isolate sectors in the event of a fire or smoke event. The work includes mechanical and controls provisions for free cooling using passive outside air during cold nights and modifications to existing intakes, louvers, and penetrations to support smoke ventilation. Localized HVAC units such as mini-splits will be installed for specific spaces, with new electrical supplies, piping, insulation, penetrations, and data reporting to the central HVAC control system. Work will be performed in an active, operational Powerhouse with 6000A, 13.8kV busbars and other heavy electrical equipment, including areas below headwater with nuisance water intrusion risks. Certain pumps must remain operational throughout construction, presenting noise and safety hazards that must be managed. The existing fire suppression system must remain active during construction and be recommissioned upon project completion. Work includes ductwork installation and protection of floor penetrations in close proximity to operational high-voltage electrical busbars, emphasizing strict delineation and safety control of work areas. New systems to be installed must not use refrigerants subject to future refrigerant phase-out schedules (no refrigerant subject to phase-out at any point in the future may be used). Work includes extensive structural penetrations and modifications to support permanent equipment installation including piping, ductwork and new condensing systems. Asbestos abatement and lead mitigation may be required. The anticipated completion date for physical construction is 1,004 calendar days after receiving the Notice to Proceed. The solicitation will be issued as an Invitation for Bids (IFB). This acquisition will result in a single firm-fixed-price contract. The estimated magnitude of construction is between $25M and $100M. This procurement is unrestricted/full and open competition. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this action is 238220; Plumbing, Heating, and Air-Conditioning Contractors with a small business size standard of $19M. One or more of the items under this acquisition is subject to the World Trade Organization Government Procurement Agreement and Free Trade Agreements. This synopsis is not a request for quotes (RFQ), proposals (RFP), or in an invitation for bids (IFB). This is a pre-solicitation notice indicating that a solicitation for a competitive acquisition for the award of one firm-fixed-price contract is intended to be issued via Contract Opportunities at SAM.gov. The tentative solicitation issuance date is June 2026. The solicitation will not be issued less than 15 days from the date of this notice. The specifications and drawings will be included with the solicitation once issued. This announcement is for information and planning purposes only and is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government, implied or otherwise, to issue a solicitation or award a contract. Bids will be due not less than 30 days from the date the solicitation is issued. The definitive bid due date and time will be stated in the solicitation and any associated amendments that may be issued. Contractors are responsible for checking this page for any update(s) to this notice. Pursuant to Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO) 4.203-1 (b), firms must be System for Award Management (SAM) registered at the time their bid is submitted. Bids from firms that have not registered or completed their online representations and certifications may be rejected. The initial registration process in SAM may take several weeks. Registration instructions may be obtained, and online registration may be accomplished, at www.SAM.gov

Die GWQ wird als Gesellschaft für Wirtschaftlichkeit und Qualität bei KK gem. § 130a Abs. 8 S. 5 SGBV für ihre Aktionärs- und Kundenkassen tätig. Bis zum In Krafttreten neuer Arzneimittelrabattverträge möchte die GWQ mit allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen Arzneimittelrabattverträge abschließen. Vertragsstart ist der 01.04.2025.

description: ДСП - Доставка на медицински изделия съгасно първоначално планиран спектър /част от документацията за участие/ с посочено естество на медицинските изделия, както и посочено прогнозно количество. Първоначално планиранираният спектър може да бъде частично изменен, както и да се добавят нови медицински изделия в хода на динамичната система. Количествата са ориентировъчни. Възложителят не e длъжен да изкупи посочените в спектъра количества. Одобрените кандидати, след покана, могат да подадат оферта за една или повече единици, както и могат да не подадат оферта. ДСП функционира на два етапа: Първи етап - събиране на заявления за участие и Втори етап - събиране на оферти по конкретни покани. Разглеждането на първоначалните заявления за участие ще се извърши в срок до 15 работни дни от крайният срок за подаване на заявления. Покана за конкретна поръчка няма да бъде обявявана преди да бъдат разгледани всички заявления. Офертите ще бъдат класир. от програма, която ще е достъпна и безплатна.

title: Switzerland – Engineering services – Zukunft Bahnhof Bern, Bausteine 1, 2, 3a, 3b, 4, 292 Bauingenieurleistung, Oberbauleitung: 12'500 h externe Projektleitung
description: Die Oberbauleitung (OBL) unterstützt die Bauherrschaft bei der übergeordneten Steuerung, Koordination und Überwachung der Realisierung des Projekts ZBBS. Sie stellt sicher, dass die Umsetzung der Bau- und Verkehrsmassnahmen gemäss den genehmigten Grundlagen und unter Einhaltung aller geltenden Vorschriften, gesetzlichen Grundlagen, Auflagen, usw. erfolgt. Die OBL überwacht und begleitet die Planerteams fachlich, technisch, sowie administrativ und stellt die Konsistenz deren Arbeiten innerhalb der Projektorganisation sicher. Die OBL begleitet die Umsetzung der Bausteine und unterstützt die zuständige Gesamtprojektleitung / Bauherrengemeinschaft - nach Bedarf - bei den anfallenden Aufgaben in technischen und koordinativen Belangen. Die OBL führt die Teams selbstständig und stellt die Umsetzung bis zum Bauende sicher. Die Aufgabe der OBL basiert auf dem Leistungskatalog gemäss SIA-Ordnung 103 für die Phasen 41 bis 53. Die OBL untersteht direkt der Gesamtprojektleitung TSB. Sie ist - gemeinsam mit den Gesamtleiterteams - zuständig für die Umsetzung Bausteine ZBBS inkl. Termin-, Kosten- und Qualitätssicherung. Die OBL koordiniert die Gesamtleiterteams, Bauleitungen, Umweltbaubegleitung sowie beauftragte Dritte und sorgt für eine abgestimmte Abwicklung der Bauarbeiten. Sie wirkt als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Bauherrschaft und Ausführung und unterstützt die Bauherrschaft in Führungs‑ und Steuerungsaufgaben. Die OBL übernimmt keine fachspezifischen Spezialmandate (z. B. Umwelt, Sicherheit, Spezialbauleitungen, usw.), sondern stellt die übergeordnete Koordination und Integration der entsprechenden Leistungen sicher. Das vorliegende Pflichtenheft basiert auf den bekannten Grundlagen zum Zeitpunkt der Erarbeitung. Sämtliche zum Zeitpunkt der Erarbeitung noch unbekannten Auflagen müssen durch die Auftragnehmerin ebenfalls erfüllt bzw. geprüft werden. Sofern dies nachweislich zu Zusatzleistungen bei der Auftragnehmerin führt, werden diese vergütet und sind durch die Auftragnehmerin zu den Konditionen des Grundauftrags zu erledigen. Die Leistungen sind im Leistungsbeschrieb (Anhang 01) detailliert aufgeführt Auf Produkte-/Marken-/Design- oder Typenbezeichnungen wird verzichtet. Sollten ausnahmsweise solche Bezeichnungen aufgeführt sein, sind gleichwertige Alternativen zugelassen. Die Gleichwertigkeit ist durch die Anbieter*in nachzuweisen.

description: Το έργο αφορά εργασίες ασφαλούς παροχέτευσης προς τον τελικό αποδέκτη των πλημμυρικών παροχών που προέρχονται από τις λεκάνες απορροής των εποχικών υδατορεμάτων, όμορων προς την Σπερχειάδα και Παλιοβράχα , οι οποίες λόγω της κλιματικής αλλαγής, της εκδηλωθείσας ήδη με τα έντονα καιρικά φαινόμενα των ισχυρών βροχοπτώσεων Ιανού, Daniel και Elias, έχουν καταστεί ιδιαιτέρως έντονες και δημιουργούν αυξημένο πλημμυρικό κίνδυνο για την ζωή και την ασφάλεια των κατοίκων. Συνοπτικά περιλαμβάνει: Α. Αγωγούς παροχέτευσης των ομβρίων, προερχομένων από τις λεκάνες απορροής χειμάρρων εποχικών υδατορεμάτων, για την διόδευση αυτών προς τους αντίστοιχους τελικούς αποδέκτες, Β. Έργα διευθέτησης του τμήματος χειμάρρου που είναι σε επαφή με τον αύλειο χώρο του Γυμνασίου – Λυκείου Σπερχειάδας και καθαρισμού τμήματος κοίτης χειμάρρου Βαλορέματος, Γ. Έργα στην περιοχή συμβολής των χειμάρρων–υδατορεμάτων στους αγωγούς παροχέτευσης των πλημμυρικών υδάτων, Δ. Έργα Αντιστηρίξεων εκσκαφών ορυγμάτων, σωληνωτών, κιβωτοειδών αγωγών και των φρεατίων ελέγχου, και στομίων επίσκεψης και συντήρησης.

title: Arten-Monitoring nach Artikel 11 und 17 der FFH-Richtlinie in Sachsen-Anhalt: Vollständiger Durchgang des Stichprobenmonitorings des Feldhamsters (Bundes- und Landesmonitoring) 2027-2028
description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Durchführung eines vollständigen Durchgangs des Stichprobenmonitorings des Feldhamsters (Cricetus cricetus) in Sachsen-Anhalt im Rahmen des Bundes- und Landesmonitorings nach Artikel 11 und 17 der FFH-Richtlinie. Die Leistung umfasst insbesondere die Vorbereitung und Durchführung der Geländeerhebungen auf festgelegten Monitoringflächen und -gebieten in den Jahren 2027 und 2028, die Erfassung populations- und habitatbezogener Parameter nach den vorgegebenen Monitoringkonzepten, die Bewertung des Erhaltungszustands der Art nach den geltenden bundes- und landesspezifischen Bewertungsschemata sowie die Aufbereitung, Dokumentation und Bereitstellung der erhobenen Daten. Bestandteil des Auftrags sind ferner die Erstellung eines Zwischenberichts sowie eines abschließenden Endberichts für den vollständigen Monitoringdurchgang einschließlich digitaler Geodaten, Datentabellen und weiterer Dokumentationsunterlagen.

description:
Cet appel d’offres concerne les travaux de fenêtres et portes extérieures en bois – CFC 221, dans le cadre de la construction du Nouveau Groupe Scolaire de Corsier.

Le lot porte principalement sur la fourniture et la pose des fenêtres, portes et ensembles vitrés extérieurs en bois, y compris vitrages, cadres, ouvrants, équipements, garnitures, tablettes intérieures, seuils, fixations, étanchéités et raccords nécessaires à leur parfaite mise en oeuvre.

Les ouvrages présentent des dimensions, compositions et typologies variées, avec plusieurs ensembles de grandes dimensions. Une attention particulière devra être portée à la qualité architecturale des menuiseries, des bois et des finitions, ainsi qu’à la précision des raccords avec les ouvrages adjacents.

Le marché nécessite une coordination étroite avec les autres lots de façade, ainsi qu’une organisation des études, fabrications et poses par zones successives, selon le phasage du chantier.

Le marché comprend notamment les études et plans d’entreprise, relevés, échantillons et mock-up, fabrication, vitrages et équipements, traitements et finitions, transport, manutention, pose, réglages, protections et toutes sujétions nécessaires à la réalisation complète des ouvrages.

description:
La direction générale des travaux (OBL) assiste le maître d'ouvrage dans la gestion globale, la coordination et la supervision de la réalisation du projet ZBBS. Elle veille à ce que la mise en œuvre des travaux de construction et des mesures de circulation s'effectue conformément aux documents de référence approuvés et dans le respect de toutes les prescriptions, bases légales, conditions imposées, etc. en vigueur.


La direction générale des travaux (OBL) supervise et accompagne les équipes de concepteurs sur les plans professionnel, technique et administratif, et veille à la cohérence de leurs travaux au sein de l’organisation du projet. L’OBL accompagne la mise en œuvre des modules et assiste la direction générale du projet / le groupement de maîtres d’ouvrage compétent – selon les besoins – dans les tâches à accomplir en matière technique et de coordination. L’OBL dirige les équipes de manière autonome et garantit la mise en œuvre jusqu’à la fin des travaux.


La mission de l’OBL repose sur le cahier des charges conformément au règlement SIA 103 pour les phases 41 à 53.


L’OBL relève directement de la direction générale du projet TSB. Elle est – conjointement avec les équipes de direction générale – responsable de la mise en œuvre des modules ZBBS, y compris la gestion des délais, des coûts et de la qualité. L’OBL coordonne les équipes de direction générale, les directions des travaux, le suivi environnemental des travaux ainsi que les tiers mandatés, et veille à une exécution coordonnée des travaux. Elle fait office d’interface centrale entre le maître d’ouvrage et les exécutants et assiste le maître d’ouvrage dans ses tâches de direction et de pilotage.


Le présent cahier des charges repose sur les principes connus au moment de son élaboration. Toutes les exigences encore inconnues à ce moment-là doivent également être respectées ou vérifiées par le prestataire. Dans la mesure où il est prouvé que cela entraîne des prestations supplémentaires pour le prestataire, celles-ci seront rémunérées et devront être réalisées par le prestataire selon les conditions du contrat de base.


Les prestations sont détaillées dans la description des prestations (annexe 01)


Il est renoncé à toute mention de produits, de marques, de designs ou de types. Si, à titre exceptionnel, de telles mentions figuraient, des alternatives équivalentes sont autorisées. L’équivalence doit être prouvée par le soumissionnaire.

title: Acadia National Park
description: Sealed bids from certified Small Business Concerns only will be accepted for Acadia National Park, Project ME NP ACAD BRG(2), Solicitation Number 693C73-27-B-000002, located in Hancock County, Maine. The project consists of repair of Main Route 233, Paradise Hill, and Frazer Creek Bridges. The work includes reconstruction of asphalt concrete pavement and aggregate base course, placement of structural backfill, cleaning and removing debris from weepholes and inlets, cleaning and sealing joints, erosion repair, repointing mortar joints, placing waterproofing membrane to improve the service life, and other miscellaneous work. The project will be split into multiple work schedules/contract options, with the cost of the entire project expected to fall within the price range of $2,000,000 to $3,000,000. Bid documents should be issued on or about October 9, 2026. Bid due date and location will be specified on the SF 1442, Block 13a of the Solicitation. Use Internet address https://www.sam.gov (click on Contract Opportunities, then type �693C73� in the Search Contract Opportunities box and click the search button and all available projects will be listed) to check for the availability of advertisement documents. All documents can be directly downloaded from this website. Solicitation documents will not be mailed. Register to receive email notifications to be automatically notified when a document is added or updated for a specific project. If firms do not register as an interested vendor at this website, there will be no Interested Vendors List. Please send all questions concerning construction projects to eflhd.contracts@dot.gov. Include the solicitation number, project name and number, requesting firm and address, a point of contact and telephone number. Requests for 'faxing' or overnight mailing will not be accepted. title: Collaboration Opportunity: Efficient Adsorptive Recovery of HREEs and Critical Minerals from Coal Derivatives
description: Opportunity: NETL is actively seeking collaboration to advance and commercialize an innovative adsorptive method for the highly efficient recovery of Heavy Rare Earth Elements (HREEs) and other Critical Minerals (CMs) from coal and its derivatives. This groundbreaking approach integrates physical enrichment for feedstock pre-concentration, significantly enhancing overall process efficacy. Background: Traditional HREE/CM extraction from coal derivatives is often costly, energy-intensive, and chemical-laden. Existing multi-step chemical extraction operations rely on vast amounts of expensive solvents and chemicals, resulting in low recovery and impure products due to inherently low REE concentrations. The heterogeneity of coal byproducts also demands complex pre-treatment, preventing a universal solution. Thus, there is an urgent need for cost-effective extraction technologies that significantly reduce chemical and energy consumption while offering feedstock flexibility. Description: NETL researchers have developed a process for the cost-effective recovery of concentrated HREEs and other critical minerals (CMs), including Gallium, Germanium, Vanadium, Cobalt, and Nickel. This method significantly reduces processing time to less than 5 minutes, demonstrates high selectivity for HREEs and CMs over fouling metals exceeding 1,000, and is proven effective with coal, coal refuse, and their derivatives. The core process involves an adsorptive technology to recover HREEs and CMs from coal and coal-derived solutions, followed by the release of high-purity HREEs and CMs through a pH-swing regeneration operation. Configured with multiple adsorption columns, the method can be continuously operated. It also incorporates a physical separation step, flotation or sonication enhanced flotation, for pre-concentrating REEs within the feedstock. This unique NETL method successfully recovers HREEs and CMs from feedstocks even at parts-per-million concentrations. By offering unparalleled low-maintenance requirements, affordability, and scalability compared to existing alternatives, it establishes a new standard for HREE/CM recovery technology. Advantages/Benefits: Improved cost efficiency. Minimal pressure drop. High capacity and selectivity for HREEs Short sorption contact times. Regenerable and robust performance tested in cyclability studies. Potential Applications: Coal refuse/waste streams Mine tailing/waste streams Acid mine drainage Industrial demineralization Development Status: Current stage of technology development: TRL ? 0-2 ? 3-5 ? 5-9 NETL has filed for patent protection on this invention. NETL is actively seeking industry partners with the capability and vision to bring this critical technology to market. By moving this innovation beyond the laboratory and into commercial application, our partners can gain a significant competitive advantage through licensing and/or cooperative research and development collaborations. Interested parties are invited to discuss this opportunity further under non-disclosure agreements to safeguard proprietary information. NOTE: THIS IS NOT A PROCUREMENT. Entities interested in developing technologies for HREE and CM recovery should provide an electronic or written statement of interest, which includes the following: 1. Company Name and Address 2. The name, address and telephone number of a point of contact 3. A description of the relevant expertise and/or facilities Please provide a complete statement to ensure consideration of your interest in this opportunity. The subject heading in an email response should include the Notice ID and the title of the opportunity and be directed to the Primary and Secondary points of contact listed below.

title: Q301--Reference Lab Services - Saginaw
Haleiwa Small Boat Harbor Maintenance Dredging and Revetted Mole Repair, Haleiwa, Oahu, Hawaii
description: This PRESOLICITATION NOTICE is posted in accordance with RFO Subpart 5.1. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Honolulu District hereby announces its intent to issue an unrestricted solicitation for a Design-Bid-Build construction project entitled, �Haleiwa Small Boat Harbor Maintenance Dredging and Revetted Mole Repair, Haleiwa, Oahu, Hawaii.� The Government intends to award a firm fixed-price construction contract utilizing Sealed Bidding procedures prescribed at RFO Part 14. Project Description: Conduct maintenance dredging by mechanical clamshell dredge to remove shoaled material within the harbor Federal limits that have accumulated over time. Maintenance dredging is needed to restore Haleiwa Harbor to its authorized depths [-12 ft Mean Lower Low Water (MLLW)] and ensure continued safe vessel navigation. The project also includes repairs to selected areas of the revetted mole structure, including small vegetation removal, removal of two large trees, filling voids in armor stone layer, and resetting an approximately 130-foot section of the revetted mole armor layer. The major elements of this project include: pre-mobilization activities; compliance with all applicable environmental requirements; mobilization, which includes preparation of temporary construction staging; mechanical clamshell dredging of accumulated sediments estimated at 4,260 cubic yards (CY); transportation and disposal of material to the South Oahu Offshore Dredged Material Disposal Site; revetted mole repair and vegetation/tree removal; and demobilization, which includes the restoration of the temporary construction staging area to its original condition. Dredging layer thickness varies, up to 7 feet. The estimated period of performance is 200 calendar days. The estimated price range is between $1,000,000 and $5,000,000. The solicitation is anticipated to be issued in July 2026. An organized site visit will be conducted at Haleiwa Small Boat Harbor (66-105 Haleiwa Road, Haleiwa, HI 96712) on Friday, July 24, 2026, at 10:00am Hawaii Standard Time (HST). It is the Offeror�s responsibility to check for any posted changes to the solicitation. Interested Offerors must register as a Vendor in Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) and be active in the System for Award Management (SAM) to submit bids for the upcoming solicitation. Please review the vendor registration instructions at https://piee.eb.mil/xhtml/unauth/web/homepage/vendorGettingStartedHelp.xhtml and see https://www.sam.gov for more information.

description: Titlu: Echipamente generale de laborator (divizate pe loturi) Legislația aplicabilă: Legea nr. 98/2016 privind achizițiile publice, cu modificările şi completările ulterioare și Hotărârea Guvernului nr. 395/2016 pentru aprobarea Normelor metodologice de aplicare a prevederilor referitoare la atribuirea contractului de achiziție publică/acordului-cadru din Legea nr. 98/2016 privind achizițiile publice Divizare pe loturi: DA (21 de loturi). Fiecare lot, cu exceptia Lot nr. 1, include cate un echipament specific de laborator [Lot 2- moara centrifugala de laborator, Lot 3- centrifuga de laborator, Lot 4- etuva de uscare cu vid, Lot 5- liofilizator de laborator, Lot 6- Vâscozimetru rotațional, Lot 7- Camera creștere plante, Lot 8- Evaporator rotativ (rotavapor), Lot 9- Titrator automat, Lot 10- Baie cu ultrasunete , Lot 11- Centrifugă de laborator, Lot 12- Granulator, Lot 13- Baie de apă termostatată, Lot 14- Bidistilor automat, Lot 15- Congelator stocare probe, Lot 16- Nișă chimică de laborator, Lot 17- Instalație automată pentru demineralizare apă/demineralizator/dedurizator, Lot 18- Digestor cu microunde, Lot 19- Baie de nisip pentru laborator, Lot 20- Digestor termostatat (Kjeldahl) si Lot 21- Aparat determinare pH, conductivitate (Multiparametru)]. Lotul nr. 1 (Lot 1) este alcătuit din 2 echipamente de laborato cu funcții similare (Balanță tehnică de precizie și Balanță analitică). Tip contract: contract de achiziție publică de produse Durată contract: maxim 4 luni de la semnarea contractului de către ambele părți Valoarea totală estimată: 748.600 lei fără TVA. cheltuielile fiind asigurate din fonduri europene, respectiv din proiectul intitulat ”Fertilizanți inovativi cu eliberare controlată pentru o agricultură durabilă (acronim AGROINOFERT)”, Cod proiect: SMIS 336222, Contract: Nr. 530 / 12.11.2025, Program de finanțare „Regiunea Centru” 2021-2027, PRC/525/PRC_P1/OP1. Procedură selectată: licitație deschisă Justificare necesitate achiziție: în cadrul acestei proceduri vor fi achiziționate produse necesare efectuării activităților de cercetare, dezvoltare și inovare în scopul asigurării atingerii obiectivelor și indicatorilor de realizare și rezult atribuite proiectului de cercetare definit mai sus. Utilizarea echipamentele propuse spre achiziționare este definită de următoarele aspecte: ♦ preparare, caracterizare, furnizare și conservare/stocare mostre de hidrolizate proteice și complecșii acestora cu microelemente esențiale cu rol de biostimulatori pentru fertilizanți; derivați ureo-aldehidici cu eliberare controlată de azot și componenți hidrofobizanți pe bază de sulf petrolier; ♦ elaborare tehnologie de laborator TRL 4 pentru obținerea de componenți hidrofobizanți pe bază de sulf petrolier, intermediari în recepturile de fertilizanți inovativi cu eliberare controlată (efectuarea experimentărilor de realizare a formulărilor de fertilizanți inovativi); ♦ efectuare experimentări de optimizare a parametrilor tehnologici de obținere a componenților hidrofobizanți pe bază de sulf petrolier; ♦ elaborare Tehnologie TRL 6 de obținere a fertilizanților inovativi cu eliberare controlată, cu conținut de Sulf petrolier și biostimulatori (efectuarea experimentelor și optimizarea tehnologiei); ♦ caracterizare analitică a intermediarilor și fertilizanților inovativi obținuți și stocarea/conservarea acestora; ♦ testare biologică și agrochimică a recepturilor de fertilizanți inovativi în camera de creștere propusă spre achiziționare.

title: Finland – Construction work – Kaivokselan koulu korjaus ja tilamuutokset
description: Hankinta käsittää Kaivokselan koulun perusparannus –hankkeen rakennusurakan / pääurakan työt urakkalaskenta-asiakirjojen mukaisesti. Työt tehdään tilaajan laadituttamien suunnitelmien mukaan. Rakennusurakoitsija toimii pääurakoitsijana. Tilaaja hankkii pääurakkaan alistettavina sivu-urakoina: putki-, ilmanvaihto-, sähkö- ja rakennusautomaatiourakat. Rakennusurakoitsija toimii myös urakan ajan kohteen päätoteuttajana sekä työmaan johtovelvollisuuksista ja työmaapalveluista vastaavana urakoitsijana. Urakkakilpailu toteutetaan avoimella menettelyllä. Tilaaja on tarjouspyynnössä määrittänyt tarjoajalta vaadittavat kelpoisuus- /soveltuvuusehdot. Halvimman (vertailuhinta) tarjouksen antanut kelpoisuusehdot täyttävä urakoitsija valitaan pääurakoitsijaksi. Vuonna 1966 valmistuneeseen koulurakennukseen tehdään sisäpuolinen peruskorjaus ja kohteen piha-alueelle tehdään muutoksia. Isoimpina muutoksia pintarakenteiden uusimisien lisäksi ovat mm. ruokasalin ja keittiön uusiminen toiseen sijaintiin rakennuksessa, kahden hissin rakentaminen, katolla olevien IV-konehuoneiden laajennukset koneineen sekä alapohjarakenteiden uusimiset suunnitelmien mukaan ja purunpoistotilan laajennus. Koulu ei ole käytössä rakentamisen aikana. Rakennuskohteen nimi: Kaivokselan koulu korjaus ja tilamuutokset Kaivosvoudintie 10 01610 Vantaa

title: Planungsleistungen zur Wärme-Kälte-Infrastruktur im Klärwerk Gut Marienhof
description: Das gegenständliche Planungsprojekt umfasst die vollständigen Planungsleistungen über die HOAI-Leistungsphasen 1 bis 8 mit stufenweiser Beauftragung. Die ausgeschriebenen Leistungen beinhalten alle dafür erforderlichen Planungen (inkl. bauzeitliche Provisorien) aus den Bereichen Ingenieurbau inkl. Planung der Verkehrsanlagen (die Freianlagenplanung erfolgt durch den externen Landschaftsplaner der AG), Tragwerksplanung, Planung der technischen Ausrüstung (Verfahrenstechnik/Anlagenbau/HLK; Elektrotechnik sowie Prozessleittechnik) und die Koordination dieser Planungen untereinander. Weiterhin obliegt dem Objektplaner die Koordination des Gesamtprojektes. Auf die ausführliche Leistungsbeschreibung in den Vergabeunterlagen wird verwiesen. Der Projektumfang umfasst: Die Versorgungsinfrastruktur wird in vier Bereiche aufgeteilt Wärme, Kühlung, Kälte und Betriebswasser. Das Betriebswasser und Trinkwassernetz sind nicht Teil dieser Maßnahme. Ein Teil der aktuellen Kühlung wird über das Betriebswasser realisiert, daher gibt es eine komplexe Schnittstelle, die zu berücksichtigen ist. Das Projekt beinhaltet die drei Themenbereiche Wärme, Kühlung und Kälte (nur Versorgungsleitung zur Kälteerzeugung im Projektumfang). Die Planung soll für die gesamte Maßnahme durchgeführt werden. Die Ausführung ist in zwei wesentliche Bauabschnitte zu unterteilen. Im ersten Bauabschnitt sind alle Maßnahmen, die dem Wärmenetz zugeordnet sind auszuführen. Im weiteren Bauabschnitt sind die Maßnahme zur Optimierung des Kühlwassersystems zu realisieren. Bei der Auslegung der Systeme ist das Optimierungspotenzial in den Betriebszuständen zu benennen. Bei der Planung der Anlagen ist eine hohe Effizienz der Energieübertragung bzw. -ausnutzung umzusetzen. Hierbei sind die wirtschaftlichen und umwelttechnischen Gesichtspunkte zu berücksichtigen. Für das Projekt ist eine Förderung nach BEW (Bundesförderungsrichtlinie effiziente Wärmenetze) beim Bundesamt für Wirtschaft und Ausfuhrkontrolle (BAFA) beantragt. Eine Beauftragung der beschriebenen Planungsleistungen kann erst nach Vorliegen des Bescheides durch das BAFA erfolgen. Bei Bewilligung sind die Anforderungen entsprechend zu berücksichtigen. Um einen Gesamtüberblick über die Örtlichkeiten und Anforderungen zu erhalten, bietet die Münchner Stadtentwässerung einen Vor-Ort-Termin zu Besichtigung in der 43. und 44. Kalenderwoche an. Die Terminkoordination findet über die Vergabeplattform statt.

title: Pelastuslaitosten virkavaatteet
description: Pelastuslaitosten virkavaatteet Hankinnan kohteena on pelastuslaitosten virkavaatteet tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä määritellyn mukaisesti. Virkavaatteiden hankinta toteutetaan hankintarenkaana, jossa Pohjois-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue (Pohde) vastaa valtuutettuna hankinnasta. Hankintarenkaassa on mukana 26 organisaatiosta, jotka koostuvat hyvinvointialueista, pelastuslaitoksista, Uudenmaan pelastusliitosta, Pelastusopistosta, Sisäministeriöstä, Lupa- ja valvontavirastosta sekä Finlands Svenska Brand- & Räddingsförbund:sta. Tarkka lista hankintayksiköistä löytyy hankintasopimuksesta. Pelastusviranomaisen on käytettävä virkatehtävissään pelastustoimen virkapukua, jollei virkatehtävän laatu tai luonne muuta edellytä. Pelastuslaitoksen muun henkilöstön velvollisuudesta käyttää pelastustoimen virkapukua päättää pelastuslaitos. Pelastustoimen virkapukua käytetään Pelastusopiston henkilöstön virkapukuna ja Pelastusopiston opiskelijoiden opiskelijapukuna. Pelastustoimen virkapukuun kuuluva vaatetus, asusteet ja varusteet on määritelty virkapukuasetuksessa ja tarkemmin pelastustoimen virkapuvun tuotekuvausohjeessa. Virkapuvun käyttöön liittyvä ohjeistus määritellään pelastustoimen virkapukuohjeessa. Pelastustoimen virkapukuun kuuluvat vaatteet, asusteet ja varusteet on jaettu virkapukuasetuksessa neljään asukokonaisuuteen: asemavaatetus, toimistovaatetus, vierailuvaatetus ja juhlavaatetus. Virkapukuasetuksessa määritellään, mitä merkkejä ja tunnuksia virkapukuun kuuluvissa varusteissa käytetään ja mihin ne kiinnitetään. Virkapuvussa käytetään vain asetuksessa ja ohjeessa määriteltyjä merkkejä ja tunnuksia. Virkapukujen ja tunnusten tuotekuvaukset on esitetty liitteessä 1.1 Pelastustoimen virkapuvun tuotekuvausohje 2025. Osatarjouksia ei hyväksytä. Hankinnan kohteesta poikkeavia vaihtoehtoisia tarjouksia ei hyväksytä. SOPIMUSKAUSI Tämän hetkisen arvion mukaan sopimus tulee voimaan tammi-helmikuussa 2027. Sopimuskauden pituus on viisi vuotta. Sopimuskauden alussa varataan aikaa sopimuksen käyttöönotolle, joka pitää sisällään materiaalien hankinnan ja tuotteiden hyväksynnän. Sopimuksen käyttöönottoon varataan kokonaisuudessaan noin kahdeksan (8) - yhdeksän (9) kuukautta aikaa. Sopimuskauden aikana tehdään reklamaatioiden ja/tai palautteiden pohjalta tuotekehitystyötä mm. materiaalien ja mitoitusten osalta. Sopimuskauden viimeisen kuuden kuukauden aikana varastot ajetaan alas portaittain, jolloin toimitusvarmuus heikkenee. Varsinais-Suomen hyvinvointialue on mukana hankintarenkaassa, mutta tekee hankinnassa oman hankintapäätöksen sekä hankintasopimuksen.,

title: Incubator Programs for Secure Facilities and Networks at Universities
description: Pursuant to Section 1071 of Public Law 119-60, the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2026 (Section 1071), the Department of War (DoW) is conducting an assessment on the feasibility, advisability, and potential benefits of establishing incubator programs for the development, operation, and sustainment of secure facilities and networks at select institutions of higher education. This RFI seeks detailed information from institutions capable of: Establishing or expanding secure facilities and networks Accelerating the transition of innovative technologies to DoW mission use Increasing availability of secure spaces to support classified research and development (R&D), prototyping, secure collaboration, and research transition activities Expanding the cleared technical workforce Serving as a regional innovation hub supporting multi-tenant use (DoW, industry, and academia) Long-term economic sustainment with significant non-federal cost-sharing The Department intends to use RFI responses to inform its assessment to Congress on the feasibility, advisability, and potential benefits to the Department of establishing the incubator programs described in Section 1071. The purpose of this information request is to ensure that any potential assessment provided to Congress and any subsequently authorized incubator program are grounded in realistic construction, security, governance, and sustainment planning. Early identification of cost, compliance, and institutional commitment factors is intended to reduce risk for both the U.S. Government and participating institutions. This RFI is for planning and assessment purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation.

title: Veterans Affairs St. Louis Health Care System (VASTLHCS) John Cochran (JC) Hospital in St. Louis, Missouri
description: ****Amend 0002 posted 20260902: Provide specifics for the site visit****Amend 0001 posted 20260817: Provide correct Plans Room Key****VA Hospital Solicitation Notice W912DQ26RA060. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Kansas City District is issuing a solicitation for an Integrated Design and Construction (IDaC) services delivery method contract for the construction of a new bed tower, clinical expansion, parking garage in support of the Veterans Affairs St. Louis Health Care System (VASTLHCS) John Cochran (JC) Hospital in St. Louis, Missouri. Offerors shall submit an offer subject to Project Labor Agreement (PLA) requirements in accordance with RFO 22.5, Project Labor Agreements for Federal Construction Projects. Any PLA reached pursuant to the PLA requirements in the solicitation does not change the terms of the contract or provide for any price adjustment by the Government. Funds are fully available for this requirement. The project will be solicited as full and open (unrestricted). The requirements under this construction project include right sizing the VAs medical center by demolishing several deficient and underutilized buildings and then constructing multiple new modern and seismically compliant structures and facilities on the same, expanded site. The newly constructed facilities are incorporated into a master plan for future expansion and demolition of additional primary facilities. The new primary facilities will be acquired using the Integrated Design and Construction (IDaC) delivery method which includes a Pre-Construction Services Phase. The Government will evaluate the performance capability of offerors in accordance with the criteria described in the solicitation resulting in a single award under the best value continuum using the trade-off process in accordance with RFO 15.103-1 to the responsible offeror whose proposal the source selection authority determines conforms to the solicitation, is fair and reasonable, and offers the best overall value to the government, considering non-priced factors described in the solicitation and price. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code is 236220, (Commercial and Institutional Building Construction), with a small business size standard of $45 million in average annual receipts. The estimated construction magnitude is over $1,000,000,000. The estimated performance period for the pre-construction services phase is 820 calendar days from Notice to Proceed (NTP).Interested offerors must have an active registration in the System for Award Management (SAM). If the offeror is a Joint Venture (JV), the JV entity must have valid SAM registration in the SAM database representing the JV as one business/firm/entity. A Proposal Guarantee will be required with your proposal in the amount of 20% of the Offerors proposed price or $3,000,000, whichever is less. Payment and Performance Bonds will be required for the full amount (100%) of the awarded contract before the Notice to Proceed can be issued. Point of Contact: The point of contact for all questions/inquiries is Michael France at michael.g.france@usace.army.mil and David Walsh (Contracting Officer) at david.j.walsh@usace.army.mil.

buyer: Office fédéral des routes (OFROU), Division Infrastructure routière Est, Filiale de Zofingue
title: MP-130008, N02 Tunnel de Seelisberg, 2e remise en état Lot 3.1 Ventilation du tunnel
description:
Le tunnel de Seelisberg fait partie de l’autoroute A2 entre les cantons de Nidwalden et d’Uri et constitue ainsi un maillon important de la liaison autoroutière entre la partie nord de la Suisse, plus étendue, et le Tessin, au sud. Le portail nord se trouve au-dessus du lac des Quatre-Cantons, près de Beckenried (NW), tandis que le portail sud est situé à Bolzbach, Seedorf (UR), sur la rive ouest du lac d’Uri. Il a été construit entre 1971 et 1980.

L’EES du tunnel de Seelisberg présente des âges différents en raison de mesures de maintenance et de remplacement partiel. Répartie en étapes et en différents lots, l’EES doit désormais être mis à niveau selon l’état actuel de la technique.


Le présent lot 3.1 couvre la remise en état de l’installation de ventilation du tunnel, comprenant notamment :

19 révisions des installations de ventilation du tunnel

19 remplacements de moteurs des installations de ventilation du tunnel avec adaptation de la tension de service

buyer: Office fédéral des routes (OFROU), Division Infrastructure routière Est, Filiale de Zofingue
title: MP-130008, N02 tunnel du Seelisberg, 2. remise en état Lot 1.1 Approvisionnement en énergie de moyenne tension
description:
Le tunnel du Seelisberg fait partie de l’autoroute A2 située entre les cantons de Nidwald et d’Uri, constituant ainsi un élément important de la liaison autoroutière entre la partie nord de la Suisse et le sud du Tessin. Le portail nord se situe à Beckenried, dans le canton de Nidwald, tandis que le portail sud se trouve à Bolzbach, dans la localité de Seedorf (UR), sur la rive ouest du lac d’Uri. Il a été construit entre 1971 et 1980.

Les équipements d’exploitation et de sécurité (EES) du tunnel du Seelisberg se trouvent à différents stades de leur cycle de vie en raison des mesures d’entretien et de remplacement partiel. Il convient désormais de les ramener à l’état actuel de la technique, de façon échelonnée et en différents lots.


Le présent lot 1.1 couvre le remplacement progressif de l’approvisionnement énergétique pendant l’exploitation en cours (exploitation en parallèle), ainsi que la fourniture et l’installation d’environ :

27 transformateurs

18 convertisseurs de fréquence (aération)

10 appareillages de commutation à moyenne tension

Commande : commande d’installation, commande locale / surveillance de l’approvisionnement énergétique

Installation basse tension des galeries d’évacuation des matériaux appelées Schutterstollen (sous-station de Beckenried et nouvel accès à la centrale de ventilation de Rütenen, ainsi que le démantèlement et l’évacuation des anciens composants de l’approvisionnement énergétique.)

title: Germany – Public-service buses – Elektrifizierung der Linienbusflotte – Rahmenvereinbarung für die Neubeschaffung bis zu einem Niederflur-Elektro-Gelenkbusses und bis zu sechs 12 Meter Niederflur-Elektro-Solobusse für die Hausemann & Mager GmbH & Co. KG
description: Ziel dieser Ausschreibung ist die Beschaffung bis zu einem Niederflur-Elektro-Gelenkbusses und bis zu sechs Niederflur-Elektro-Solobusse für die Hausemann & Mager GmbH. Hiermit soll die bestehende Fahrzeugflotte gezielt modernisiert und im innerstädtischen Linienbetrieb zunehmend auf emissionsfreie Fahrzeuge umgestellt werden. Das übergeordnete Ziel des Projekts besteht darin, den öffentlichen Personennahverkehr nachhaltiger, umweltfreundlicher und leiser zu gestalten und damit einen aktiven Beitrag zum Klimaschutz sowie zur Verbesserung der Luftqualität zu leisten. Die ausgeschriebene Leistung umfasst die Lieferung betriebsbereiter Neufahrzeuge, die sämtliche technischen und funktionalen Anforderungen der Vergabeunterlagen erfüllen. Der Einsatz moderner Elektrobusse trägt dazu bei, den Fahrgastkomfort zu erhöhen, die Barrierefreiheit weiter zu verbessern, die Energieeffizienz zu steigern sowie die langfristige Leistungsfähigkeit eines zeitgemäßen öffentlichen Verkehrsangebots sicherzustellen. Folgende Hauptleistungen sind Inhalt dieser Ausschreibung: - Lieferung eines betriebsbereiten Niederflur-Elektro-Gelenkbusses - Einweisung der Mitarbeitenden der Hausemann & Mager GmbH - Durchführung von Bedienerschulungen gemäß DGUV Die Rahmenvereinbarung wird in zwei Fachlosen vergeben. Los 1 - Lieferung bis zu einem betriebsbereiten Niederflur‑Elektro‑Gelenkbusses einschließ-lich Einweisung des Bedienpersonals Los 2 - Lieferung von bis zu sechs betriebsbereiten Niederflur Elektro Solobussen ein-schließlich Einweisung des Bedienpersonals

description: Sous l'impulsion de la planification coordonnée régionale, cantonale et de l'agglomération, le programme de développement des métros m2-m3 (programme m2-m3) a été articulé pour répondre à deux objectifs principaux: * Renforcer la capacité de transport entre la gare et le centre ville afin de répondre à la demande générée par l'offre ferroviaire à la gare de Lausanne, * Lier les sites des Plaines-du-Loup et de la Tuilière au centre ville de Lausanne. Le métro m3 reliera directement la gare des CFF à Chauderon, sans arrêt au Flon. Cela permettra de créer une nouvelle interface majeure de mobilité au centre ville à Chauderon, grâce à une liaison souterraine avec la rue de Genève, notamment, et de mieux organiser le réseau de transports publics, pour une meilleure répartition des voyageurs. Le métro m2 sera quant à lui modernisé en priorité, c'est-à-dire que ses automatismes, qui lui permettent de fonctionner sans conducteur à bord, seront remplacés et ses rames rénovées. Sa capacité sera augmentée. Des prestations initiales de mandataires Système et Equipements ont été réalisées à la suite de deux appels d'offres de l'Etat de Vaud. En raison de la modification des mécanismes de financement et des besoins organisationnels des projets, les tl souhaitent adjuger 2 nouveaux mandats pour effectuer la suite du projet par le biais du présent appel d'offres.

title: France – Real estate agency services on a fee or contract basis – Contrat de mandat de gestion locative et technique d'ensembles immobuliers appartenant aux SCI de l'Association Foncière Logement
description: Cette consultation concerne la gestion locative et technique de 54 ensembles immobiliers (dont 431 existants et 23 neufs ) totalisant 10.615 logements situés sur l’ensemble du territoire national (69 départements). La présente consultation concerne deux types de mission : 1°) l’administration de biens, complète, d’un ensemble immobilier ; la gestion locative et technique sera globale et concernera à la fois les parties privatives et les parties communes, partielles ou totales ; 2°) l’administration de biens de logements situés dans des ensembles immobiliers en copropriété ; la gestion locative et technique ne concernera que les parties privatives, ainsi que la gestion des relations avec le syndic et la représentation du mandant. Dans les deux cas la mission englobe la recherche de locataires pour les logements vacants sauf avis contraire de l’Association. Elle concerne deux types de biens différents : - Logements à loyers conventionnés : programmes conventionnés déjà en service pour lesquels le mandat de gestion actuel arrive à son terme - Logements à loyers libres : programmes à loyer libre déjà en service (pour lesquels le mandat de gestion actuel arrive à son terme), ou neufs (dont la livraison correspond à la date d’effet du mandat, réalisés dans des quartiers à dominante de logement social, ou à proximité immédiate) Les conditions générales des mandats sont identiques pour les deux types de biens, mais les conditions particulières différent selon que les programmes sont neufs ou existants. • Le gestionnaire sera le mandataire des SCI propriétaires ; il devra gérer l’ensemble immobilier au nom et pour le compte du mandant, dans le respect des dispositions de la loi dite loi « Hoguet » du 2 janvier 1970, et des textes venus la compléter ou la modifier et également de la loi n° 2014-366 du 24 mars 2014 (ALUR). A cet égard, il est précisé que les missions objet des contrats conclus avec les gestionnaires sont pleinement soumis à l’ensemble de cette réglementation ou toute réglementation ultérieure, sans qu’il soit nécessaire de modifier les mandats, et que les gestionnaires sont tenus d’une obligation de respect cette réglementation dans la réalisation de l’ensemble des actes et prestations objet des mandats de gestion ; • Il devra assurer au mieux des intérêts du mandant la gestion administrative de l’ensemble immobilier (validation des dossiers des candidats locataires et organisation des visites, gestion des baux de location et de l’APL, gestion du contentieux locatif, administration de l’ensemble immobilier, gardiennage, etc.). • Il assurera également la gestion technique de l’ensemble immobilier, y compris la prise de possession des biens neufs au cours de laquelle il représentera le mandant, les états des lieux, les contrats de maintenance et d’entretien, les travaux d’entretien courant, les travaux de gros entretien et de grosses réparations, la gestion des sinistres, la consultation des entreprises. • Il procèdera à la gestion comptable et à la reddition des comptes. • Il devra assurer l’information du mandant par un « reporting » permanent et régulier, en utilisant des supports mis à sa disposition par le mandant (notamment un portail Internet), dans des délais déterminés sous peine de sanctions. Il se soumettra à tous les contrôles, enquêtes et audits, directs du mandant ou que celui-ci fera réaliser par des intervenants extérieurs ou encore qui seraient réalisés par les organismes de contrôle auxquels le mandant est soumis (exemple : audit ou enquête de l’Ancols ou de la Cour des comptes). Il s’engage à fournir toutes explications et documents qui lui seraient réclamés et à coopérer de bonne foi avec Foncière logement, ses filiales et les organismes de contrôle

description: Das AKK plant auf dem Gelände Bleickenallee 38 in Hamburg Altona Umbaumaßnahmen im Gebäude "Reha Aufstockung" um drei weitere Geschosse. Das Bestandsgebäude ist teilunterkellert, im Untergeschoss befinden sich Technikräume und Umkleiden, das Erdgeschoss wird weiterhin als Rehabilitationseinrichtung genutzt. Das Reha-Gebäude wird gemäß § 2 HBauO in die Gebäudeklasse 5 eingestuft. Im 1. Obergeschoss der Aufstockung wird eine teilstationäre Tagesklinik untergebracht, die als Ersatzfläche für die Baufeldfreimachung des Ersatzneubaus I-Haus dient. Die Station beinhaltet überwiegend Untersuchungsräume für diagnostische Zwecke sowie Liegeräume, in denen Patienten Infusionen erhalten. Dienende Räume wie Stützpunkt, Arbeits- und Lagerräume, Sanitärräume und Verteilküche ergänzen das Raumangebot. Die dreigeschossige Aufstockung wird in Stahlbetonbauweise errichtet, bestehend aus tragenden Außenwänden sowie tragenden Wänden und Stützen im Gebäudeinnern. Die Decken werden aus Fertigteilelementen in Verbundbauweise als Spannbeton-Hohlplattendecken mit deckengleichen Verbundträgern geplant. Die Außenwände erhalten ein WDVS-System mit Riemchenverkleidung. Die Aufstockung erhält ein extensiv begrüntes Flachdach mit Photovoltaikmodulen. Die Baumaßnahme soll unter Aufrechterhaltung des laufenden Krankenhausbetriebes erfolgen. Die Zufahrt zur Baustelle erfolgt über die Lisztstraße; sämtliche Zuwege zu Ein- und Ausgängen sowie Feuerwehr- und Rettungswagenzufahrten sind in jedem Fall freizuhalten. Die Abriss- und Anschlussarbeiten müssen mit Rücksicht darauf durchgeführt werden.

description: La présente consultation a pour objet la conclusion d’un contrat de concession de service public, soumise aux dispositions des articles L. 1411-1 et suivants du CGCT et R. 1411-1 et suivants du CGCT, ainsi qu’à l’article L. 1121-3 et suivants de la troisième partie du code de la commande publique.
